SELECT /* homes.batch.mapper.BatchMapper.selectBatchBaseOutLine */ A.TOTAL_REGSTR_PK AS TOTAL_REGSTR_PK , A.BULD_REGSTR_PK AS BULD_REGSTR_PK , A.BULDGB AS BULDGB , A.BULDGB AS CPLX_AT , A.ARCD AS ARCD , A.LEGCD AS LEGCD , A.BUNJIB AS BUNJIB , A.BUNJIJ AS BUNJIJ , A.RDCODE AS RDCODE , A.RDLEGCD AS RDLEGCD , A.UNDER_AT AS UNDER_AT , A.RD_MAIN_BUN AS RD_MAIN_BUN , A.RD_SUB_BUN AS RD_SUB_BUN FROM TB_HBD_TEMP_BSOUTLINE A WHERE A.BATCH_DE = #{batchde} AND A.BATCH_AT = #{batchAt}
SELECT /* homes.batch.mapper.BatchMapper.selectBatchJobListCount */ COUNT(1) AS T_CNT FROM TB_CM_BATCHJOB WHERE DATE_FORMAT(BT_ST_DT, '%Y%m%d') >= #{btstde}

SELECT /* homes.batch.mapper.BatchMapper.selectBatchJobList */ BATCHNO AS BATCHNO , BT_UUID AS UUID , BATCHTY AS BATCH_TY , BT_STTUS_CD AS BT_STTUSCD , DATE_FORMAT(BT_ST_DT, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i:%s') AS BTST_DT , DATE_FORMAT(BT_ED_DT, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i:%s') AS BTED_DT , NVL(BT_EXCO, 0) AS BT_EXCO , BT_FILENM AS BT_FILENM , BT_ERROR_MSG AS BT_ERRORMSG FROM TB_CM_BATCHJOB WHERE DATE_FORMAT(BT_ST_DT, '%Y%m%d') >= #{btstde} ORDER BY BATCHNO DESC LIMIT #{stno}, #{edno}

SELECT /* homes.batch.mapper.BatchMapper.selectRelatedMaster 홈즈_관리대장_마스터에 등록된 대표지번 조회 */ A.HTBDNO, A.BULD_REGSTR_PK, A.ARCD, A.LEGCD, A.BUNJIB , A.BDADDR, A.RDADDR, A.BULDNM, A.RDCODE, A.RD_MAIN_BUN FROM TB_HBD_LEDGR_MASTER A INNER JOIN TB_RD_RDMASTER_JIBUN B ON ( A.ARCD = SUBSTR(B.ARCODE, 1, 5) AND A.LEGCD = SUBSTR(B.ARCODE, 6, 5) AND A.BUNJIB = B.BUNJIB AND A.RDCODE = B.RDCODE AND A.RD_MAIN_BUN = B.RD_MAIN_BUN ) WHERE A.ARCD = #{arcd} AND A.LEGCD = #{legcd}

SELECT /* homes.batch.mapper.BatchMapper.selectBaseOutLine 홈즈_관리대장_기본개요 조회 */ TOTAL_REGSTR_PK, BULD_REGSTR_PK, BULDGB, ARCD, LEGCD FROM TB_HBD_TEMP_BSOUTLINE WHERE BATCH_DE = #{batchde} AND BATCH_AT = #{batchAt}
AND TOTAL_REGSTR_PK IS NOT NULL AND TOTAL_REGSTR_PK != ''
AND ( TOTAL_REGSTR_PK IS NULL OR TOTAL_REGSTR_PK = '' )
AND DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT /* homes.batch.mapper.BatchMapper.selectBaseLedgrMstr 홈즈_관리대장_마스터 등록조회 */ A.TOTAL_REGSTR_PK, A.BULDGB, A.ARCD, A.LEGCD, A.BUNJIB, A.BUNJIJ , A.BULDNM, A.BDADDR, A.RDADDR , A.PPSCD, A.PPSETCNM , A.HSHLDCO, A.FMLYCO, A.BULDCO, A.BULDSUBCO, A.HOSILCO, A.PARKNGCO , A.RDCODE, A.RDLEGCD, A.UNDER_AT, A.RD_MAIN_BUN, A.RD_SUB_BUN , A.TOTAL_REGSTR_PK, A.TOTAL_AR, A.PLAT_AR, A.BULD_AR, A.BULK_CALC_TOT_AR, A.BULD_LND_RT, A.BULK_RT , A.CONFDE, A.CRDE , CASE WHEN NVL(B.HTBDNO, 'EMPTY') = 'EMPTY' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS HAS_YN , CASE WHEN NVL(B.HTBDNO, 'EMPTY') = 'EMPTY' THEN ( SELECT CONCAT('HTB' , LPAD(A.BULDGB, 2, '0'), A.ARCD, A.LEGCD , LPAD(NVL(MAX(SUBSTR(HT.HTBDNO, 15)), 0) + 1, 7, '0')) FROM TB_HBD_LEDGR_MSTR HT WHERE HT.BULDGB = A.BULDGB AND HT.ARCD = A.ARCD AND HT.LEGCD = A.LEGCD ) ELSE B.HTBDNO END AS HTBDNO , CASE WHEN A.HSHLDCO >= 30 /* 30세대 이상 */ AND A.BULDCO >= 1 /* 1개동 이상 */ THEN '3' ELSE A.BULDGB END AS CPLX_AT FROM TB_HBD_TEMP_LEDGR_MSTR A LEFT JOIN TB_HBD_LEDGR_MSTR B ON A.TOTAL_REGSTR_PK = B.TOTAL_REGSTR_PK WHERE A.TOTAL_REGSTR_PK = #{totalRegstrPk}
SELECT /* homes.batch.mapper.BatchMapper.selectNullLegcdList */ TA.ARCD, COUNT(1) AS HAS_CNT FROM ( SELECT ARCD FROM TB_BD_TITLE_LEDGR WHERE LEGCD IS NULL LIMIT 1 ) TA GROUP BY TA.ARCD
SELECT /* homes.batch.mapper.BatchMapper.selectConvArcodeList */ ARCODE, LEGCODE , AR_FULL_NM AS ARNAME FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE WHERE ARCODE = #{arcode} AND ARLEVEL = 3
mapper.sql: WITH TMP_BASE_SUMMRY AS ( SELECT HTBDNO, BULDGB, ARCD, LEGCD, BUNJIB, BUNJIJ , CASE WHEN TOTAL_REGSTR_PK IS NULL OR TOTAL_REGSTR_PK = '' THEN BULD_REGSTR_PK ELSE TOTAL_REGSTR_PK END AS BULD_REGSTR_PK , CASE WHEN TOTAL_REGSTR_PK IS NULL OR TOTAL_REGSTR_PK = '' THEN 'B' ELSE 'T' END AS PKEY_TY , COUNT(1) AS BULDCO FROM TB_HBD_BASE_SUMMRY WHERE BATCH_DE = #{batchde} AND BATCH_AT = #{batchAt} GROUP BY HTBDNO, BULDGB, ARCD, LEGCD, BUNJIB, BUNJIJ ) , TMP_BASE_SUMMRY_MSTR AS ( SELECT HTBDNO , BULD_REGSTR_PK , BULDGB, ARCD, LEGCD, BUNJIB, BUNJIJ , PKEY_TY , BULDCO , CASE WHEN PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_HBD_TEMP_LEDGR_MSTR MS WHERE SM.BULD_REGSTR_PK = MS.TOTAL_REGSTR_PK ) WHEN PKEY_TY = 'B' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_HBD_TEMP_LEDGR LD WHERE SM.BULD_REGSTR_PK = LD.BULD_REGSTR_PK ) END AS HASCO FROM TMP_BASE_SUMMRY SM ) , TMP_LEDGR_MSTR_T AS ( SELECT A.HTBDNO , A.BULD_REGSTR_PK , NVL(B.BULDGB, A.BULDGB) AS BULDGB , CASE WHEN NVL(B.BULDGB , A.BULDGB) = '2' AND NVL(B.BULDCO , A.BULDCO) >= 1 AND NVL(B.HSHLDCO, 0 ) >= 30 THEN '3' ELSE NVL(B.BULDGB, A.BULDGB) END AS CPLX_AT , NVL(B.ARCD , A.ARCD) AS ARCD , NVL(B.LEGCD , A.LEGCD) AS LEGCD , NVL(B.BUNJIB, A.BUNJIB) AS BUNJIB , NVL(B.BUNJIJ, A.BUNJIJ) AS BUNJIJ , NVL(B.BULDNM, '') AS BULDNM , NVL(B.BDADDR, '') AS BDADDR , NVL(B.RDADDR, '') AS RDADDR , NVL(B.PPSCD , '') AS PPSCD , NVL(B.PPSETCNM, '') AS PPSETCNM , '' AS ESTCD , NVL(B.HSHLDCO , 0) AS HSHLDCO , NVL(B.FMLYCO , 0) AS FMLYCO , NVL(B.BULDCO , A.BULDCO) AS BULDCO , NVL(B.BULDSUBCO, 0) AS BULDSUBCO , NVL(B.HOSILCO , 0) AS HOSILCO , NVL(B.PARKNGCO , 0) AS PARKNGCO , NVL(B.RDCODE , '000000000000') AS RDCODE , NVL(B.RDLEGCD , '00000') AS RDLEGCD , NVL(B.UNDER_AT , '0') AS UNDER_AT , NVL(B.RD_MAIN_BUN, '00000') AS RD_MAIN_BUN , NVL(B.RD_SUB_BUN , '00000') AS RD_SUB_BUN , NVL(B.TOTAL_AR , 0.0) AS TOTAL_AR , 0.0 AS SUPPLY_AR , NVL(B.PLAT_AR , 0.0) AS PLAT_AR , NVL(B.BULD_AR , 0.0) AS BULD_AR , NVL(B.BULK_CALC_TOT_AR, 0.0) AS BULK_CALC_TOT_AR , NVL(B.BULD_LND_RT , 0.0) AS BULD_LND_RT , NVL(B.BULK_RT , 0.0) AS BULK_RT , NVL(B.CONFDE, '') AS CONFDE , NVL(B.CRDE , '') AS CRDE , A.HASCO AS HASCO , CASE WHEN A.HASCO > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS USE_YN , A.PKEY_TY AS PKEY_TY , #{batchde} AS BATCH_DE , CASE WHEN A.HASCO > 0 THEN '2' ELSE '1' END AS BATCH_AT FROM TMP_BASE_SUMMRY_MSTR A LEFT JOIN TB_HBD_TEMP_LEDGR_MSTR B ON A.BULD_REGSTR_PK = B.TOTAL_REGSTR_PK ) , TMP_LEDGR_MSTR_B AS ( SELECT A.HTBDNO , A.BULD_REGSTR_PK , NVL(B.BULDGB, A.BULDGB) AS BULDGB , CASE WHEN NVL(B.BULDGB , A.BULDGB) = '2' AND NVL(B.BULDCO , A.BULDCO) >= 1 AND NVL(B.HSHLDCO, 0 ) >= 30 THEN '3' ELSE NVL(B.BULDGB, A.BULDGB) END AS CPLX_AT , NVL(B.ARCD , A.ARCD) AS ARCD , NVL(B.LEGCD , A.LEGCD) AS LEGCD , NVL(B.BUNJIB, A.BUNJIB) AS BUNJIB , NVL(B.BUNJIJ, A.BUNJIJ) AS BUNJIJ , NVL(B.BULDNM, '') AS BULDNM , NVL(B.BDADDR, '') AS BDADDR , NVL(B.RDADDR, '') AS RDADDR , NVL(B.PPSCD , '') AS PPSCD , NVL(B.PPSETCNM, '') AS PPSETCNM , '' AS ESTCD , NVL(B.HSHLDCO , 0) AS HSHLDCO , NVL(B.FMLYCO , 0) AS FMLYCO , NVL(B.BULDCO , A.BULDCO) AS BULDCO , 0 AS BULDSUBCO , NVL(B.HOSILCO , 0) AS HOSILCO , 0 AS PARKNGCO , NVL(B.RDCODE , '000000000000') AS RDCODE , NVL(B.RDLEGCD , '00000') AS RDLEGCD , NVL(B.UNDER_AT , '0') AS UNDER_AT , NVL(B.RD_MAIN_BUN, '00000') AS RD_MAIN_BUN , NVL(B.RD_SUB_BUN , '00000') AS RD_SUB_BUN , NVL(B.TOTAL_AR , 0.0) AS TOTAL_AR , 0.0 AS SUPPLY_AR , NVL(B.PLAT_AR , 0.0) AS PLAT_AR , NVL(B.BULD_AR , 0.0) AS BULD_AR , NVL(B.BULK_CALC_TOT_AR, 0.0) AS BULK_CALC_TOT_AR , NVL(B.BULD_LND_RT , 0.0) AS BULD_LND_RT , NVL(B.BULK_RT , 0.0) AS BULK_RT , NVL(B.CONFDE, '') AS CONFDE , NVL(B.CRDE , '') AS CRDE , A.HASCO AS HASCO , CASE WHEN A.HASCO > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS USE_YN , A.PKEY_TY AS PKEY_TY , #{batchde} AS BATCH_DE , CASE WHEN A.HASCO > 0 THEN '2' ELSE '1' END AS BATCH_AT FROM TMP_BASE_SUMMRY_MSTR A LEFT JOIN TB_HBD_TEMP_LEDGR B ON A.BULD_REGSTR_PK = B.BULD_REGSTR_PK ) SELECT A.HTBDNO, A.BULD_REGSTR_PK, A.PKEY_TY , A.BULDGB, T.CPLX_AT , A.ARCD, A.LEGCD, A.BUNJIB, A.BUNJIJ , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.BULDNM ELSE B.BULDNM END AS BULDNM , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.BDADDR ELSE B.BDADDR END AS BDADDR , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.RDADDR ELSE B.RDADDR END AS RDADDR , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.PPSCD ELSE B.PPSCD END AS PPSCD , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.PPSETCNM ELSE B.PPSETCNM END AS PPSETCNM , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.HSHLDCO ELSE B.HSHLDCO END AS HSHLDCO , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.FMLYCO ELSE B.FMLYCO END AS FMLYCO , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.BULDCO ELSE B.BULDCO END AS BULDCO , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.BULDSUBCO ELSE B.BULDSUBCO END AS BULDSUBCO , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.HOSILCO ELSE B.HOSILCO END AS HOSILCO , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.PARKNGCO ELSE B.PARKNGCO END AS PARKNGCO , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.RDCODE ELSE B.RDCODE END AS RDCODE , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.RDLEGCD ELSE B.RDLEGCD END AS RDLEGCD , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.UNDER_AT ELSE B.UNDER_AT END AS UNDER_AT , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.RD_MAIN_BUN ELSE B.RD_MAIN_BUN END AS RD_MAIN_BUN , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.RD_SUB_BUN ELSE B.RD_SUB_BUN END AS RD_SUB_BUN , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.TOTAL_AR ELSE B.TOTAL_AR END AS TOTAL_AR , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.PLAT_AR ELSE B.PLAT_AR END AS PLAT_AR , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.BULD_AR ELSE B.BULD_AR END AS BULD_AR , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.BULK_CALC_TOT_AR ELSE B.BULK_CALC_TOT_AR END AS BULK_CALC_TOT_AR , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.BULD_LND_RT ELSE B.BULD_LND_RT END AS BULD_LND_RT , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.BULK_RT ELSE B.BULK_RT END AS BULK_RT , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.CONFDE ELSE B.CONFDE END AS CONFDE , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.CRDE ELSE B.CRDE END AS CRDE , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.BATCH_DE ELSE B.BATCH_DE END AS BATCH_DE , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.BATCH_AT ELSE B.BATCH_AT END AS BATCH_AT , CASE WHEN A.PKEY_TY = 'T' THEN T.USE_YN ELSE B.USE_YN END AS USE_YN , #{mngrno} AS CREAT_USER_NO , #{mngrno} AS UPDT_USER_NO FROM TMP_BASE_SUMMRY_MSTR A LEFT JOIN TMP_LEDGR_MSTR_T T ON A.BULD_REGSTR_PK = T.BULD_REGSTR_PK LEFT JOIN TMP_LEDGR_MSTR_B B ON A.BULD_REGSTR_PK = B.BULD_REGSTR_PK WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM TB_HBD_LEDGR_MSTR MS WHERE A.HTBDNO = MS.HTBDNO )

SELECT A.HTBDNO, A.HBDNO, A.BULD_REGSTR_PK , A.BULDGB, A.ARCD, A.LEGCD, A.BUNJIB, A.BUNJIJ , B.BULDNM, B.DONGNM, B.BDADDR, B.RDADDR, B.PPSCD, B.PPSETCNM , #{cfmvgb} AS CFMVGB , B.CONFDE AS CONFDE , B.RIDNG_ELVTR_CO, B.EMGR_ELVTR_CO , B.GRNDCO, B.UNDERCO, B.HSHLDCO, B.FMLYCO, B.HOSILCO , A.RDCODE, A.RDLEGCD, A.UNDER_AT, A.RD_MAIN_BUN, A.RD_SUB_BUN , B.TOTAL_AR, B.BULD_AR, B.PLAT_AR , B.CRDE , A.BATCH_DE AS BATCHDE , #{afBatchAt} AS BATCH_AT , #{mngrno} AS CREAT_USER_NO , #{mngrno} AS UPDT_USER_NO FROM TB_HBD_BASE_SUMMRY A INNER JOIN TB_HBD_TEMP_LEDGR B ON A.BULD_REGSTR_PK = B.BULD_REGSTR_PK WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM TB_HBD_LEDGR LD WHERE A.HTBDNO = LD.HTBDNO AND A.HBDNO = LD.HBDNO ) AND A.BATCH_DE = #{batchde} AND A.BATCH_AT = #{batchAt}
